baselines.note: Timed on the customer's own cluster; the run log is attached to the baseline record.

candidates.name: Qubitized quantum phase estimation
candidates.rationale: The only candidate with a published resource analysis for an instance of this size.

expected_runtime.source: Surface-code runtime model at the plan's pinned scenarios.
assumptions: No queueing delay is charged to the run.
limitations: Modelled, not measured. No device was run to produce this figure.

expected_credits.source: Expected runtime at the tariff pinned in this plan.
assumptions: The tariff in force on the plan date applies for the whole run.
limitations: An estimate. The ceiling that actually binds the run is max_credits.

data_handling: Inputs and outputs stay in the customer's tenancy; only hashes leave it.
success_criteria: A physical-qubit count for each pinned scenario, with its assumptions stated.
A stated condition under which the quantum workflow would beat the measured baseline.
refusal_criteria: No classical baseline survives review, so no economic comparison can be drawn.
The estimate is infeasible at every pinned scenario, so there is no condition to state.
execution_limitations: One QEC scheme is modelled. Other codes are not costed by this plan.
A fixture. It pins the study-v1 projection and float rendering, and describes no real study.
